rows.grounds: ablative of cause indicating predominance of knowledge
compound of cin, mātra, and lakṣaṇa in nominative masculine singular

items.question: Why is the accomplished state characterized by consciousness alone despite knowledge predominance?
premises: accomplishment is characterized by consciousness alone
items.inference: therefore the accomplished state is defined by consciousness alone
uncertainties: exact referent of saḥ is not explicit in this verse
items.plain_english: Because of the predominance of knowledge, of accomplishment, but that is characterized by consciousness alone.
